t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Try different coloured gnomes and shapes. Flat gnomes are better in the first round but the cone shapes ones are better taking it in turns. Different colours can give different points.

vb_textbox.text: The game seems utterly random in terms of how you get points! I could determine no relevance of the colour or shape of gnome as to how many points you receive. If there is a pattern, I have no idea!
